_doc: Per-phase spec modules built from marked sections of spec/CLAUDE-extended.md by scripts/build-spec-modules.js. loadsOn is the index line in core; triggers is the tier-2 regex (case-insensitive; written for Oniguruma, the engine jq and so the hook uses; JS, used only for calibration, differs on \b next to CJK, where Oniguruma counts the CJK character as a word character, and on \d, which in Oniguruma also matches full-width digits; these are the two that matter for the triggers, not a complete list: write [0-9], and bound an English word with (?<![A-Za-z0-9_]) … (?![A-Za-z0-9_]) instead of \b, which is JS's ASCII \b written out, so both engines agree next to CJK, _ and digits), matched against the whole prompt (window whole) or its first 300 characters (window head). Calibration: tasks/specs/spec-modules.md r2, whose prompt counts r6 corrects. v9.0.0 keeps only ship and review (tasks/specs/spec-v9-lean-2026-11-25.md).

ship.loadsOn: before tagging, releasing, publishing or deploying
ship.triggers: 发版|发布(新)?版本|(?<![开触研出批激散引])发\s*v?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+|(推送|合并)\S{0,4}\s*发布|打\s*(个|一个)?\s*tag|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])ship(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])cut a release(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|create-release|merge-and-push|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])release(?![A-Za-z0-9_]).{0,40}(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])to npm(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|npm publish|gh release|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])deploy(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|上线

review.loadsOn: when reviewing work or spawning a reviewer, including the pre-tag review
review.triggers: 评审|审查|审核一下|code review|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])review (the|this|my|it)(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])PR review(?![A-Za-z0-9_])
